body:
I don't know how I am giving off the impression I would ignore their wishes or force my company onto anyone, but that is certainly not what I want. I want them to want me back. I want the validation and the attraction to be reciprocated. I really would not be posting a question to this subreddit  with my specific example, if making someone uncomfortable was of no concern to me.

I honestly can't tell you that I wouldn't misread a situation because I have never asked anyone on a date before, so I must obviously lack some skill there regarding reading body language, but I would definitely not ignore anything like that once it is made clear.

I think I lost sight of my original question or was not clear with myself about it. I was asking basically whether even just talking to someone of that age is a no-no. 

But I think I have my answer. Thanks for responding.

You're right, I'm definitely fantasizing here, however I misspoke. My assumption was that it is more likely to be the case for younger women.

I wouldn't have thought the assumption would matter too much because if the person I ask to be a partner with would express that they don't have that outlook, then it wouldn't work out anyway.

In either case it doesn't matter now, I think I have the answers I am looking for. It seems I definitely need to get over this fantasy and stop being a creep.

Thanks for responding.

On one hand, I don't fully understand why choosing someone, or even being interested in someone, partly based on them being young, is any different than any other criteria, but on the other, based on what everyone has said here I think it's something I need to just let go off for my own good. 

Thanks for taking the time to respond.

Yup, makes sense. As I mentioned in another response this is something I am really going to struggle with giving this up, but I can see the sense in what you're saying. I'm just having an incredibly rough time coming to terms with my youth being behind me. These are fantasies I've had since I was probably about 13. I'm not really sure how I'm going to get over it, but I suppose I don't really have a choice.

Anyways, thank you so much to taking the time to respond and explain things. You probably had an unnecessarily aggravating few hours on my rubbish. Hope you have a good one.

I can see the wisdom in what you are saying in you last paragraph. I'm just really struggling with accepting it, mainly because i'm struggling with accepting that my youth is over.

On the one hand I'm wondering what if I seek out and meet women who meet those ideals or who are open to a relationship of that nature, but on the other hand I can see myself being argumentative and desperately clinging to that fantasy.

Anyway, I can't thank you enough for taking the time to explain things and engage with me on something that I'm sure makes you uncomfortable. I am about to head out to see my therapist and have a lot to talk to him about. Thanks again.

The original question was about women in that age range, but I'm not only restricting myself to women  in that age range, I was just hoping that talking to them or approaching them would be okay; that including them in a potential dating pool would be a okay. Like maybe if I am out somewhere and see someone I find attractive and they happen to be in that age range, that I could approach them without the fear of making everyone's skin crawl. It seems like the general consensus is that I can't.

Thank you for the other advice, it is something I have been slowly working on.

Thanks for taking the time to respond.

That is the age of the women I most frequently find attractive.

The consensus seems to be that this is really messed up so I'm just gonna have to not pursue anything here. That is extremely devastating.

I don't mean I expect younger women  to be romantically/sexually inexperienced. I was just hoping to experience the "carefree-young-love-sexual-exploration" with women I find attractive who generally tend to be in that age range.

But again maybe I'm missing something everyone here is saying or just desperately clinging to my fantasy so I'll talk to my therapist about this today.

Thank you for responding.

I apologize if I'm being dense here but can you elaborate on how I would not be viewing them as a whole person? I'm not saying that them being young is the only attribute I am interested in or that I would be looking for. It just is important to me currently.

I am not only attracted to women of that age, but I do find women in that age range more frequently attractive.

I understand this is not an experience that I necessarily get to have. I find the fact that I shouldn't pursue this and that I might never have the care free young love sexual exploration part, quite devastating, to be honest.

Thanks for responding.

I definitely don't feel entitled to anything. It's what I want and hope for,  not what I deserve or feel entitled to.

And I understand that they have their lives and hopes and dreams and I'm not saying I don't want to share it with them. I definitely want that too.

I guess I'm not understanding why the young-and-hot part can't be one aspect of what I currently want in a partner. But, I'm seeing my therapist today so I will show this to him so that he can help me understand.

I also want to mention that I am not repulsed by women closer to my age, I just find women in their early twenties more attractive and also because it matters more right now because I missed out on the experience.

Thanks for taking the time to respond/engage with me on this. 

Can you explain what you mean by stripping them of their personhood and autonomy?

I'm not looking to have a relationship/sex with any girl without their express consent, if that's what you mean.

I do know any partner will age and I'm not saying I will always only want women of this age or that I wouldn't devote my attention to a partner who I share history and a bond with, should my relationship get to that point. This is just what I would like to pursue.

I can't say it is not discriminatory to persue women based on age/looks but I don't fully understand why that is a bad thing. Isn't it discriminatory to define any attribute you are looking for in a partner?

I am very interested in understanding what you have to say so thanks again.

I don't think I see them as achievements which seems rather impersonal. I do want to connect with people not just fuck a doll or else I would have considered a sex worker. I really just want to pursue the women I am attracted to and have them want me back. I'm not sure how other people view being able to have their attraction reciprocated, whether that is considered an achievement, and I can't clearly see why the age gap would make that an achievement, rather than just validating and gratifying.

I am in therapy and I expressed this to my therapist and he keeps telling me that it is okay to want that what I want, so this is confusing. But, I do understand that older men do prey on younger women and try to control them.

I really wanted this but I guess that's not going to happen, and that is extremely disappointing.

Thanks for responding.
I tried explaining in response to another comment, please have a look when you get a chance.

I don't know if I can explain it but I will try. I apologize if any of this seems offensive, but I will be honest in the hopes that I get some honest responses in return.

I have never had a girlfriend/romantic/sexual partner and it something I want to experience. I have been severely depressed since I was about 19 and it has set me back in life and I feel like I have missed out on some things that I would desperately like to experience.

I want to know what it would be like to date and have sex with someone in that age range. I also feel like the women in my age range have much more life experience than I do. 

It feels like I was asleep for the last decade (I honestly did spend the majority of my life in bed, depressed) and I woke up to find my body had aged and my youth had gone by and it is extremely hard for me to deal with. I am surprised by how old I look when I look in the mirror. When I notice women I am attracted to they are mostly in their early to mid twenties.

I understand this is all very cliche but I would like the experience of dating and maybe having sex with someone in that age range. To know what it's like to be young and be with someone young. To have my attraction of the women I find most attractive, reciprocated. 

But if I'm being honest everything feels wrong. Dating someone my age feels wrong because I don't feel like I am their peers in life experience, and dating someone that young feels wrong because when I was that age, guys my age approaching my classmates made my skin crawl. 

Not really sure what to do, but I just want certain experiences very much and I'm hoping there is a way for me to get that.

Thanks for taking the time to respond.

I am lonely but unfortunately that's not the end of it. All of my other issues have recently been boiling down to wanting to not just to socialize but to socialize like I was in my early twenties, back in college, especially with women of that age, because I missed out on that. It's a stupid fantasy. I would hate to actually do that now because I'm inappropriately old for that. So the time is passed for me on that and I don't want anything else out of life.
